verdict.rationale: The site states before you begin that an account must be created to start business license registration (de-dor-docs-5), and the probe confirms that filings sit behind an authenticated session on tax.delaware.gov (de-dor-probe-4). Nothing in the evidence spells out which credentials, login method, or identity-proofing steps are involved, so the walls are largely discovered mid-flow. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of account and credential requirements, any documented identity-proofing steps (e.g., ID verification, letter or PIN mailers), prerequisites stated for tax filing rather than only license registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the flow.
